name: sahajta-ads
description: Preview and launch Meta ads from a Google Drive folder, and plan campaign and ad set changes, through the Sahajta Ads Launcher.
long_description: Ask Claude to launch a folder of creatives, create, copy or edit campaigns and ad sets in bulk, turn things on or off, and read results. Claude always shows a summary first (accounts, every budget and the total) and asks before anything runs; anything that can spend money needs the total daily budget confirmed. Nothing can be deleted. This extension only talks to the launcher's API with your personal key. It never holds the Meta token.

tools.name: (all launcher tools)
tools.description: The extension passes Claude's requests to the launcher, so new tools appear after restarting Claude Desktop.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: The connected ad account, Page and Instagram account (photo, ID, link) and login expiry

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Campaigns and ad sets you can launch into

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Copy, naming templates, settings presets and enhancement keys

tools.name: save_copy_template
tools.description: Create or edit a copy template

tools.name: save_naming_template
tools.description: Create or edit an ad, ad set or campaign naming template

tools.name: save_settings_preset
tools.description: Create or edit a settings preset (Page, Instagram, each enhancement on or off)

tools.name: preview_batch
tools.description: Build a batch from a Drive folder and show the pre-launch summary. Creates nothing in Meta.

tools.name: set_ad_copy
tools.description: Give ads in a batch their own copy

tools.name: regroup_files
tools.description: Move a file to another ad in a batch

tools.name: launch_batch
tools.description: Launch a previewed batch (paused, now or scheduled). Needs confirm: true.

tools.name: batch_status
tools.description: Progress, what was created, what failed and what to do next

tools.name: retry_failed
tools.description: Retry the failed ads of a batch

tools.name: cancel_batch
tools.description: Stop a running launch

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Campaigns and ad sets with budgets and settings

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: Every setting of a campaign or ad set

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Allowed values for objectives, goals, events, bids

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Audiences, pixels, interests, locations

tools.name: plan_changes
tools.description: Plan bulk changes to campaigns and ad sets. Nothing runs yet.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Change a plan before it runs

tools.name: confirm_plan
tools.description: Run a plan after the person's explicit yes

tools.name: plan_status
tools.description: Plan progress or recent plans

tools.name: cancel_plan
tools.description: Cancel a plan

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Results per ad, ad set or campaign with breakdowns

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: Metric names, custom metrics and column sets

tools.name: save_custom_metric
tools.description: Create or edit a custom metric

tools.name: save_column_set
tools.description: Create or edit a column set

api_key.title: Launcher API key

app_url.description: Leave as it is unless your admin tells you otherwise.
